## Symptoms
POST /orders returns 502 for every order. Requests to the pricing quote endpoint return 503.

## Likely causes
1. The pricing service is unavailable or failing on every request.
2. Its upstream price source is unreachable.

## How to confirm
Call the quote endpoint directly. A 503 on every SKU means the service is failing, not a single missing item.

## Fix options
Restart or roll back the pricing service. Raising the order service timeout does not help.

## Escalate when
The pricing service does not recover after a restart.
